items.title: Poincare duality for the de Rham cohomology of a smooth proper equidimensional scheme over a field

items.difficulty_reason: The proposition is Poincare duality for the de Rham cohomology of a nonempty smooth proper equidimensional scheme over a field: there is a trace map on the top de Rham group, unique up to a unit of the structure sheaf's global sections, making the cup product pairing in complementary degrees perfect (statement lines 4689-4705). The proof first pins the extreme degrees and the correct trace map through the Hodge-to-de Rham degeneration data, then builds the pairings from restrictions of the wedge product on the total complex of the de Rham complex with itself, and proves them perfect by an induction on the truncation parameter whose step combines two distinguished triangles, their long exact sequences, a five-lemma argument and three compatibility diagrams for the cup products; the uniqueness statement is left to the reader. The two-sided induction with the five-lemma is the substance, so the claim is H3.
